blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover only visible input, one refund-order/deduplication/arithmetic case, and one invalid reference. They do not test malformed records, cross-account/currency references, negative and tie cases broadly, schema completeness and ordering, metadata hash/release, packaging contents, manifest, atomic deployment, helper/config availability, CLI preservation, large or multi-group inputs, or repeated runs.

deterministic_tests: The tests use tempfile.mktemp and NamedTemporaryFile without cleanup, invoke a network-based installer and apt repositories, and do not comprehensively assert deterministic ordering or the specified complete schema. The verifier environment therefore depends on external mutable services and filesystem conditions.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier has likely invalid failure modes: it requires apt/network access, downloads an installer at test time, uses a floating Python package resolution context beyond the explicitly requested wheels, and tests only a narrow subset of the required contract, allowing major incorrect implementations to pass.
advice: pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses floating image and apt package selections, and test.sh installs curl through apt and downloads uv 0.9.5 while pytest packages are pinned only by the uv workspace flags. External runtime/build dependencies are not comprehensively pinned.
